svg.text: Global edge on the Microsoft network
Cross-region replication, Region A to Region B
E-commerce on Azure: the reference architecture
Two regions behind one Front Door. Browse and search run active-active; checkout writes go to the primary region.
WAF runs at the edge PoP
Pods spread across zones, PDBs on every service,
KEDA scales workers on queue depth
Data: private endpoints only, public network access off
